lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.

native.tip: Im Englischen ist „agree“ schon das Verb. Sag einfach „I agree“.
native.caption: Sagst du „I am agree“? 🙈 Falsch: “I am agree with you.” Richtig: “I agree with you.” Hör Carlos zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.tip: In English “agree” is already the verb. Just say “I agree”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am agree”? Wrong: “I am agree with you.” Right: “I agree with you.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
